about_the_game:
🕵️‍♂️ About This Game (long‑form)

Every word could save the world.

A rogue syndicate is minutes from global chaos, and only your keyboard can stop it. Built entirely in Python with Pygame, Shadow Protocol blends rapid‑fire word puzzles, neon spy visuals, and a pulse‑pounding soundtrack into a single‑player thriller.

Key Features

  • Word‑Based Spy Puzzles – crack cleverly crafted clues under a ticking timer.

  • 1‑Minute Missions – quick rounds create relentless “one‑more‑level” tension.

  • Adaptive Difficulty – helpful nudges for newcomers, brutal mind games for veterans.

  • Cinematic Synth Score – high‑energy tracks drive every operation.

  • Native macOS Build – universal app runs on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

  • Pure Single‑Player – no micro‑transactions, no online account required.

How It Works

  • A coded hint flashes on your secure terminal.

  • Type the one perfect word before time runs out.

  • Success defuses the threat; failure raises the global danger meter.

  • Clear every mission to dismantle the syndicate’s master plan.

Sharpen your wits, trust no one, and remember: one word can change everything in Shadow Protocol.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 or Higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (or better; universal build supports both)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Apple/Intel) or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

name: SHADOW PROTOCOL

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit, version 1909 or later) / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 (2 cores @ 3.9 GHz), AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Higher
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 (DirectX 9.0c/OpenGL 2.1 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible audio device (built-in Windows audio is fine)
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit, version 21H2 or later) / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (4 cores/8 threads, 1.6 GHz base / 3.4 GHz boost) or AMD Ryzen 5 3500U
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (2 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB) / Intel UHD 620 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: None

short_description: Suit up as an undercover agent in Shadow Protocol, a high‑stakes, word‑based spy puzzle built in Python/Pygame. Solve rapid‑fire word riddles, defuse missions, and groove to an epic cinematic soundtrack—all running natively on macOS.
